name: metawingman
description: AI-first, evidence-grounded, human-overseen systematic review and meta-analysis workflow.

interface.longDescription: Plan and execute evidence-grounded systematic reviews from topic selection through living updates, with typed provenance, deterministic verification, explicit abstention, and human responsibility gates.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use $metawingman to continue this systematic review from its live project state, preserve provenance, and stop at any unresolved scientific or credential gate.
